people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
translations.bsb: Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes among the ruins.
translations.kjv: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
